transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Yeah, well... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. Over these last few months, my head's just... jumping all over the place. 

I catch myself getting distracted by every little thing on the road. The CB chirping, fuel price signs, or just... random new ideas popping into my head. It's making me miss details I normally never miss. Like, uh... messing up a client's delivery note, or forgetting who I promised to call back. So... yeah. That's what finally got me to come in.
Can you tell me more about how your thoughts jump around? Does it feel like you can't focus, or like your mind is racing even when you're trying to concentrate on something specific?
I don't know... it's just hard to focus, I guess. Like, I'll be trying to look at a manifest and... my brain is just somewhere else. It's not really racing, just... not where it's supposed to be.
Do you find it hard to focus or get distracted easily in other parts of your life, like at home or when you're hanging out with friends?

Yeah, I guess it happens other places too. At work, I've had dispatch and some clients have to repeat stuff... things I should have caught the first time. And, uh, a couple of sales calls fell through because my head was just... somewhere else. 

At home... well, my wife and daughter, they've been kind of... walking on eggshells around me. I know I'm probably making things harder there when I'm just supposed to be helping out. So... yeah. It's not just the truck.
When you find yourself getting distracted, does it feel like your mind is pulling you away with thoughts of its own, or do you feel like you're reacting to things going on around you?

I guess it's... kind of both. Like I said before, it's the stuff around me. The CB radio going off, or just... looking at the signs for diesel prices. But then sometimes it's just... I don't know, a new idea pops in my head and I'm off thinking about that instead of what I'm doing. That's how I ended up messing up that delivery note. Just... getting pulled away by whatever.
Can you tell me if you often forget daily tasks, lose things, or have trouble keeping things organized, whether at work or at home?
No, I don't think so. I mean... I keep track of my stuff alright. It's not like I'm losing my keys or anything like that. I keep my truck in order. Never really had a problem with that part of it.
Do you find it harder to focus during certain parts of your day, like at work versus at home, or does it feel about the same no matter what you're doing?
I don't know... I guess it's about the same. Just... whenever my mind decides to wander, it wanders. Doesn't really matter where I am.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or as if you can't sit still for very long?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. I just... I don't really like sitting around. I keep finding extra things to do. Like, I'll start rewriting my route plans, or I'll check in on the newer guys after my shift is done. And when I'm home, I'm always fixing something. If I try to just sit still on the couch, I get kind of... antsy, I guess. Just need to be doing something.
Do you find yourself acting on impulse without thinking things through, like saying or doing something before you mean to, or feeling like you have to jump into things right away?
Not really. I mean... I usually think before I do things. I'm just driving my route, you know? I don't just... jump into stuff. I just do what needs doing.
Have you noticed these issues with focus, distraction, and restlessness in situations outside of work and home, like in social settings or when you're out running errands?
I don't really know. I don't go out much, to be honest. Just... run to the store, get what I need, and go home. I haven't really noticed anything.
Looking back, did you have trouble focusing or staying still when you were a child, like in school or at home?
I don't really remember much about being a kid, to be honest. It was a long time ago. I think I just... went to school, did my work. Nothing really stands out.
Have you noticed these same problems with your focus or restlessness when you're out in public, like at the store or anywhere else you go?
I think... I think you already asked me that. Like I said, I just go to the store and come back. I don't really pay attention to all that.

Do you ever notice yourself getting distracted or feeling restless when you're in places like restaurants, waiting rooms, or other public spaces where you might need to sit still or pay attention for a while?
Not really. I mean... if I have to wait somewhere, I just sit there until I'm done. I don't really think about it. It's just waiting.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy, even when things aren't busy or stressful?
No. I mean... I feel alright. Just working, mostly. I don't really get down like that.

Looking back as far as you can remember, were you ever noticeably different from other kids your age when it came to focus, attention, or restlessness—like having trouble sitting still or staying on task—before you turned 12?
I don't really remember that far back... but, uh, no. I don't think so. I was just a regular kid, I guess. Didn't really stand out or anything.
Do you find it hard to focus or feel restless when you're in situations like doctor’s offices, meetings, or other places where you need to sit still and pay attention for a while?
No. Like I said before... I just sit there. Driving a truck all day, you get pretty used to sitting still. So, no, it's not a problem.

Mild cognitive impairment or other organic conditions (F06.7) may also present similarly.
